usage:
Usage:
  {command} list --hub <URL> [--token-file <file>] [--session <id>] [--state <state>] [--limit <n>] [--after <cursor>] [--json] <computer-id>
  {command} retry --hub <URL> [--token-file <file>] <computer-id> <session-id> <message-id>
  {command} discard --hub <URL> [--token-file <file>] <computer-id> <session-id> <message-id>

Use a full paired-device token in --token-file or PERSONA_OUTBOX_TOKEN.
List states: waiting, sending, checking, failed.
read_only: Only a full paired device can read the Agent message outbox.
invalid_page: Use a valid state, a limit from 1 to 100, and the cursor from the same computer and filters.
unavailable: The outbox isn't available yet. Try listing it again in a moment.
checking: Checking whether this message reached the chat.
behind: An earlier message in this chat needs your decision first.
invalid_id: Provide a valid computer, session, and message ID for the action.
invalid_hub: Set --hub to an HTTPS URL or a local HTTP URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
token: Provide a full paired-device token in --token-file or PERSONA_OUTBOX_TOKEN.
action_unknown: The hub didn't confirm the action. List the outbox before trying again.
read_failed: Couldn't reach the hub to list held messages.
missing: The hub didn't serve the outbox. Check the computer ID and hub version.
bad_response: The hub returned an invalid outbox response.
heading: Held messages on {name} ({id})
more: Next page: repeat the command with --after {cursor}
retried: Retry accepted. List the outbox to check the message's state.
